# Turnesta

> Self-hosted appointment booking and electronic queue management for service businesses. The application interface is Russian. The project is licensed under AGPL-3.0.

## Product

- [English product tour](https://timeofanarchy.github.io/turnesta/): Real screens from a visitor booking, staff schedule, queue ticket, operator workspace and live display.
- [Обзор на русском](https://timeofanarchy.github.io/turnesta/ru/): Онлайн-запись, виджет на сайте, талоны по QR-коду и вызов к окну.
- [v0.1.0 pre-release](https://github.com/TimeOfAnarchy/turnesta/releases/tag/v0.1.0): Evaluation status, tested image, source archives and limitations. Tips is mock-only.

## Documentation

- [Guide index](https://timeofanarchy.github.io/turnesta/guides/): Documentation for owners, administrators and contributors.
- [Deployment](https://timeofanarchy.github.io/turnesta/DEPLOYMENT.html): Local installation, Linux hosting, measured local resource use and acceptance checks.
- [First configuration](https://timeofanarchy.github.io/turnesta/GETTING-STARTED.html): Locations, specialist schedules, staff permissions and queue setup.
- [Website widget](https://timeofanarchy.github.io/turnesta/BOOKINGS-WIDGET.html): Embed booking on an existing website.
- [Operations](https://timeofanarchy.github.io/turnesta/OPERATIONS.html): Updates, backups, restore and service limits.
